source.association: Most recent nonempty VerseId (zero-based column 12); publisher references are generally associated with section headings. sourceVerse preserves the exact table attachment location, not a claim of a verse-specific interpretive relationship.

method: Parse anchor labels and hrefs only; require exact same-chapter verse bounds, existing book/chapter/verses, and matching publisher link target. Deduplicate identical source-verse and target-range pairs. Do not derive interpretations, reciprocal links, or commentary.
